name: Meta ads and Google ads
summary: Meta and Google ads managed against booked calls and sales, not clicks.
answer: Paid ads management is planning, running and optimising advertising campaigns on platforms like Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google. HTH manages Meta and Google ads with conversion tracking connected to your CRM, so campaigns are judged on booked calls, qualified leads and sales rather than clicks. It's for businesses ready to spend on ads and wanting to know exactly what that spend returns.
whoFor: Businesses spending on ads without knowing what they return
Clinics, real estate and local services generating leads
Ecommerce brands scaling on Meta and Google Shopping
Businesses whose ad leads are poor quality

problem.heading: The ad dashboard says it's working. The bank account disagrees.
problem.body: Platforms report leads and conversions that don't match what your team sees. Cheap leads turn out to be junk, and nobody can say which campaign brought in last month's best customers.

deliverables.title: Tracking setup
deliverables.detail: Pixel, Conversions API, GA4 and offline conversions from your CRM, so platforms learn from real sales.

deliverables.title: Campaign strategy
deliverables.detail: Audiences, offers, budgets and structure for Meta and Google.

deliverables.title: Creative direction
deliverables.detail: Ad angles and briefs, plus copy, with creative tested systematically.

deliverables.title: Campaign management
deliverables.detail: Daily checks, weekly optimisation and budget moves toward what works.

deliverables.title: Lead quality loop
deliverables.detail: Lead quality from the CRM fed back into targeting.

deliverables.title: Reporting
deliverables.detail: Cost per booked call and per sale, by campaign, in one monthly report.

process.title: Audit
process.detail: We audit your account, tracking and the path from ad to sale.

process.title: Fix tracking
process.detail: Nothing scales until the numbers are right, so tracking comes first.

process.title: Launch
process.detail: New campaign structure, offers and creative, launched in controlled tests.

process.title: Optimise
process.detail: Weekly optimisation and monthly reviews against cost per sale.

timeline: Tracking and launch in 2 weeks, then ongoing monthly management.
priceFrom: [PLACEHOLDER: starting monthly management fee for ads]

faqs.question: What ad budget do we need?
faqs.answer: It depends on your market and goals. We'll recommend a test budget after the audit that's large enough to learn from without risking too much.

faqs.question: Is the ad spend included in your fee?
faqs.answer: No. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta or Google from your account. Our management fee is separate.

faqs.question: Who owns the ad accounts?
faqs.answer: You do. We work inside your accounts with partner access, so you keep all data and history.
